title: After the Tenno Sho (Spring): Bouncing Back

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (I didn't even come close! How is she so much better than me?!)

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Ryan, McQueen… We were hoping for so long that one of you would emerge victorious today, but…

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: I know. I never would've expected this. But still, moping won't help…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I may have lost today, but next time, the glory's mine!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: And I'm sure McQueen feels just the same! I know she's going to do her best to live up to all your expectations! And that's not all…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: McQueen isn't the only runner in the Mejiro family! And at the Takarazuka Kinen, I, Mejiro Ryan, will show you that I'm not to be ignored!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: …Yeah! That's right! I'll always be rooting for you, Ryan!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (And here I was feeling all sorry for myself… I didn't even think about my fans.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (But Ryan's different. She heard her fans' voices and put them at ease right away.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …Now that's someone who's lived shouldering expectations. That's what separates me and her…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I've made up my mind! At the Takarazuka Kinen, that's gonna be me!
